text.text:
The room was clean and the staff were really helpful and nice. Parking can be confusing, so make sure if you park where it says Platinum you let the staff members know. They will charge you inside the hotel. Do not pay the fee outside and inside-the hotel will give you a discounted rate for 24hrs. I made a mistake and paid double but the staff members gave me a refund without a problem.

The only complaint I have is that there was a weird smell in the room. I could not pin point what it was because the room was in fact clean. I should had let a staff member know but it wasn't that strong. Other than that everything was great. The view was great and the TV worked without problems. I checked in and out without any difficulty.  They do have karaoke nights and a bar at the bottom. This is great if you want ambience.

text.text:
I had such a beautiful and memorable stay at Aloft Austin Downtown. The hotel itself has such a vibrant and modern atmosphere, and being right in the heart of Austin made everything so convenient and enjoyable. From the moment we arrived, everything just felt easy, welcoming, and well taken care of.

What made this stay even more special was that we were celebrating my partner’s anniversary. It turned what was already a great trip into something truly meaningful and unforgettable. Every little moment felt extra special, and the overall experience gave us memories that we’ll always hold onto.

A huge thank you to Ellaine, who genuinely made our stay even more beautiful. Her warmth, kindness, and attention to detail did not go unnoticed. She went above and beyond to make sure everything felt personal and comfortable, and that kind of service really makes a difference. It’s rare to come across someone who creates such a genuine connection with guests.

Overall, it was more than just a hotel stay—it was an experience filled with great energy, meaningful moments, and exceptional service. I would absolutely come back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for something both fun and memorable in Austin.

text.text:
This hotel was perfect for my last minute stay (I booked around 440 and checked in at 530). The front desk attendants that I interacted with (Christian and another taller, black guy on my Saturday night and an older black guy on Sunday at checkout) were extremely kind, professional and personable.

The hotel lobby is quite large (including a bar-I didn’t get to try, a pool table, sitting areas, grab and go breakfast cafe-didn’t try but it was pricey, gym-nice and clean) The room was clean and roomy with a decent view, the ironing board is pretty short and my toilet had issues flushing at times but it was nothing that would deter me from booking again. Overall, I enjoyed my stay here and it was conveniently located as well, I was able to walk safely and solo to the AT@T Discovery Center. Parking was $17 daily through the hotel and $30 through the actual lot so that was a nice deal. The parking lot was huge but a little ways from the front door. However, they do have carts and up front parking for overnight guests when they don’t fill up. They also have nightly entertainment in the lobby from a solo guitar player… also, the bathroom door is the side mirror and it slides (took me a second to realize that)

text.text:
I checked out of the Element Hotel in Dallas because it felt more like staying at a no-tell motel, and the service was disappointing. Thankfully, the Residence Inn Dallas was a much better experience.
The location is perfect, the rooms are spacious, and having a full kitchen made the stay even more comfortable. Check-in was excellent, and the front desk staff member was kind enough to let me check in around 10 AM, which I really appreciated.
My only suggestion would be to add more towel holders in the bathroom. There was only one small hanger, but for a couple, at least two would be helpful.

Overall, I had a great stay and would definitely recommend this hotel.

text.text: The room is very spacious and comfy. The hotel services are excellent, and the breakfast is great! Reasonable and affordable prices for my one-week's stay. A few minutes' walk from the St Paul DART station, so it is very easy to connect to the Dallas Fort Worth International Airport by using the Orange line. You can also make use of the Green line for participating in the State Fair of Texas at the Fair Park. Highly recommended if this is the first time you visit Dallas!

Hallways are wide, our room had a great view of the tall buildings in Downtown. The room was clean and welcoming, the hotel is walking distance to Main Street. The front staff are nice and friendly, always available to assist, check in and out was a breeze! Free breakfast offered a variety of items, all hot and satisfying! Parking lot across the street is affordable with an easy to pay process online. 10/10, will stay here at this hotel again!
